sources.citation: Jarvis, Elizabeth. 1989. Esquisse grammaticale du podoko. In Daniel Barreteau & Robert Hedinger (eds.), Descriptions de langues camerounaises, 39-127. Paris: ACCT/ORSTOM. (IRD Horizon fdi:27061, open access)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 1.2 'Rappel phonologique' (pp.41-42) gives consonant/vowel charts, the palatalisation prosody and 'Il y a deux tons phonologiques. Seul le ton haut est marque.'; sec. 1.3 describes tone perturbation of words after pause and final-vowel -> -a before pause; sec. 4.6 'Ton' (pp.97-98) verb tone classes. No mention of accent/stress anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent + read).

sources.note: The listed open copy is only the volume front matter : open_url returned HTTP 404 and the current sil.org links ( and the full) not reachable by automated download (an automated-access block), the Internet Archive unreachable. The Parkwa content of this volume is the Swackhamer chapter, already downloaded in our earlier reading (via the Internet Archive id_ mode, tesseract 200 dpi) together with the volume's title page, TOC and map (pp. i-vi; the preface p. vii is not in that scan). Re-read in full for stress/accent/prominence/intonation: only the orthographic 'acute accent' for H tone (p. 98…

sources.citation: Swackhamer, Jeanette. 1991. Tonal behavior of Podoko verbs in independent clauses. In Stephen C. Anderson (ed.), Tone in five languages of Cameroon (SIL/UTA Publications in Linguistics 102), 93-125. Dallas: SIL & University of Texas at Arlington. SIL archives 8917.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. 'Like many Chadic languages, Podoko has basically a two-tone system' with downstep of L (three heights, two registers), phrase-final downtilt, clause-initial grammatical downstep marking present tense (spectrograph evidence), clause-final 'intonation' variants noted in passing; 627-verb tone-class appendix.

sources.citation: WALS Online, language 'Podoko' (wals code pod): 30 datapoints, all sourced to Jarvis 1989; PHOIBLE park1239: inventory AA 808 (Chanard & Hartell) only.
sources.access_detail: read online, no copy kept
sources.note: No stress features (13A-17A absent) in WALS; PHOIBLE segmental only.
